source_scope.selection_policy: First-third completion audit. Only a source-image-checked natal clause with self-contained conditions is approved; adjacent passages with unresolved inherited context, missing text, or an unmapped section label are retained as explicit rejections.

reviewer_method: Compared the retained page image with the local two-column OCR and extraction draft. Conditions were rewritten only with canonical chart facts; inherited section assumptions were not silently supplied.
